title: Fallback Lattice: Policy Authoring Walkthrough & Console Preview
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Proposal and acceptance criteria for a new Console-first workflow that lets customers author, validate, and preview 'fallback lattice' routing policies. These policies express region selection, capacity tier routing, and ordered fallback model variants in a single authoring surface. The feature bundles: a policy DSL editor with realtime validation, a visual lattice preview that simulates request flows across regions/tiers, and safety checks that prevent unsafe fallthroughs to lower-trust models or unapproved regions.
goals: Make it simple for platform teams to express prioritized routing: region -> tier -> model-variant fallback
Surface validation errors and safety warnings inline before save
Provide a stochastic preview/simulator for expected request distribution under common failure scenarios
Enable exporting a JSON policy bundle compatible with runtime routing APIs and for Dedicated/Private deployments
acceptance_criteria: Console editor supports creating a policy with at least three ordered fallback levels (region, capacity tier, model variant)
Editor shows realtime validation for missing constraints, circular fallbacks, and cross-region disallowed fallthroughs
Preview simulates 1,000 requests and shows heatmap of served model variants across regions and tiers
Save produces a versioned policy artifact that the runtime can consume (docs + sample JSON)
Design review signoff and accessibility checks completed
Automated unit tests for editor validation and simulator under CI
engineering_notes: Depends on runtime API extension ENG-2045 for prioritized fallthroughs and variant mapping
Simulator will run client-side WebAssembly worker to avoid server costs; can be optionally run server-side for large sims
Validation rules implemented in shared routing-validation library (reuse existing validator from ENG-9123)
Telemetry: attach suggestion hints based on historical traffic (requires telemetry read permission)
Performance trade-off: live validation on large policies may need debounce to avoid blocking typing
design_feedback: Design review (2026-03-05) - prefer explicit lock icon for production policies to avoid accidental edits
UX comment - add guided templates for common patterns (region-first, cost-first, latency-first)
Accessibility - ensure lattice visual uses texture + color, not color alone
engineering_feedback: ENG lead (Marco Chen) - propose initial backend schema using 'ordered_buckets' array to map region->tier->variant
SRE - add circuit-breaker guardrails for policy rollouts that target new model variants
Security - verify KMS access for Private deployments when exporting artifacts
risks_and_tradeoffs: Complexity vs simplicity: exposing the full lattice gives power but increases chance of misconfiguration; mitigated with templates and safety checks
Simulator accuracy: sampling-based preview may not reflect edge-case KV-cache behavior under low-latency routing
Rollout surface: supporting both Hosted and Private runtimes requires a lightweight export format that different runtimes can map to their internal routing graphs
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Editor prototype + local validation (Client-only) - 2 sprints
Phase 2: Simulator + visual lattice + templates - 1 sprint
Phase 3: Backend policy store + versioning + export endpoint + runtime integration tests (ENG-2045) - 2 sprints
Phase 4: Canary rollout, metrics collection, and docs - 1 sprint
